BiblicalUsage: Shalleketh is a gate on the west side of the temple, by the causeway of the going up. The lot fell to Shuppim and Hosah there, and the gatekeepers kept their wards against wards, each one facing the other across the courts.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God stations His gatekeepers by lot, and every gate of His house has a name and a keeper.
